title: Neon Coil
description: Grow the longest glowing snake in the arena. Make rivals crash into you and swallow their light.
controls: Steer with your mouse or finger. Hold the mouse button, Space, or the ⚡ button to boost (costs length).

title: Flip Rider
description: Stunt motocross across 8 tracks. Land flips to knock seconds off your time.
controls: → / D = gas, ← / A = brake & reverse. In the air: gas = backflip, brake = frontflip. R = restart. On phones use the on-screen pedals.

title: Rumble Truck
description: Crawl a monster truck over crates, bridges, seesaws and canyons. Don't flip it!
controls: → / D = gas, ← / A = brake & reverse. In the air, gas/brake tilt the truck. R = restart. On phones use the on-screen pedals.
